Torrential rainfall from 11 to 14 September 2019 caused major flooding
in south-eastern Spain.
Ontinyent in Valencia Province recorded 296.4 mm of rain in 24 hours on
12 September. This is equivalent to about half the yearly average and is the
second highest daily rainfall total on record for Ontinyent.
By 12 September several rivers had broken their banks. The overflowing
Segura river caused major flooding in the town of Orihuela, Alicante Province,
and flooding from the Cànyoles river in Moixent, Valencia Province, caused
major problems.
